text: AgroViet 2026 to showcase sustainable agriculture technologies and products

The 26th International Agriculture Trade Fair (AgroViet 2026) will take place in Hanoi from November 12 to 15, bringing together more than 100 domestic and international organizations and enterprises to showcase agricultural products, technologies, and equipment that support sustainable agricultural development, according to an announcement by the Vietnam Agricultural Trade Promotion Center (Agritrade) at a press briefing on November 2.

Speaking at the press briefing, Director of Agritrade, Mr. Nguyen Minh Tien, said that during the first nine months of 2026, Vietnam's exports of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products reached $56.3 billion, up 7.8% year-on-year, while the sector posted a trade surplus of $16.9 billion.

According to Mr. Tien, AgroViet 2026 is expected to feature more than 250 standard booths, with participation from over 100 organizations and businesses representing 25 provinces and cities across Vietnam, as well as several countries and territories, including China, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and ASEAN member states.
The specialized international exhibition area and other themed display zones will cover a total area of more than 1,000 sq.m.

Exhibits will include key agricultural products, high-export-value commodities, OCOP (One Commune One Product) products rated three stars and above, high-tech agricultural products, crop varieties, livestock breeds, and aquaculture products.

The fair will also showcase agricultural inputs such as biofertilizers, biological crop protection products, agricultural machinery, greenhouse and net-house systems, drip irrigation technologies, and equipment for the processing, preservation, and storage of agricultural products.
Services supporting agricultural value chains, including packaging, logistics, cold storage, traceability labels, distribution systems, and e-commerce platforms, will also be featured at the event.

A new highlight of AgroViet 2026 is the expanded display of environmental protection technologies and equipment, along with dedicated exhibition spaces for science and technology products and innovative startups involved in digital transformation and green transformation initiatives.
Particularly noteworthy is the international exhibition zone for agricultural machinery, equipment, production inputs, and post-harvest processing technologies.
Covering approximately 50 standard booths, the area will bring together companies from Japan, China, and Vietnam.

Featured products will include agricultural machinery, food-processing equipment, fertilizers, vegetable and fruit seeds, crop protection products, veterinary products, livestock and aquaculture supplies, Aquaponics circular-farming models, and greenhouse materials.

In addition, an international pavilion comprising around 50 standard booths will showcase agricultural products, deeply processed seafood products, and consumer goods from enterprises in Henan province, China.
